_comment: Topics excluded from the published hierarchy. EXCLUDED MEANS SCORED BUT NOT PUBLISHED (ADR docs/adr-taxonomy-change-propagation.md, D7): these topics stay in taxonomy_v2.json, keep accumulating TOPIC# rows, and cost scoring spend every Monday; they are withheld only from hierarchy.json. Per D8 each entry carries as_of + evidence so the recorded rationale can be checked rather than trusted — both entries were stale for months before the 2026-08-03 audit. Re-test when a topic's activity_count doubles from its recorded value (with a floor, so small topics do not trip on 1->2). The re-test is #307's overlap measurement, not a subjective quality call.

excluded_topics.reason: Domain-overlapping methodology topic: 2178 of its 2179 distinct PMIDs are already covered by at least one other topic, so publishing it as a research area would re-file existing work rather than surface new work. Retained in the taxonomy because it still scores usefully as a methodology signal.

evidence.activity_count_method: TOPIC#implementation_science row count, fully paginated Query
evidence.caveat: High overlap is NOT distinguishing on its own: across all 69 topics the median share of PMIDs covered by another topic is 100.0%, 40 topics have zero unique PMIDs, and this topic ranks 16th. #307 retired hematology_medical_oncology on a restricted 10-cancer-topic denominator (88.6%), which is a different metric and not comparable to this corpus-wide figure. Keeping this topic excluded rests on it being a methodology label whose overlap with domain topics is definitional — not on the overlap percentage, which would condemn most of the taxonomy.
evidence.supersedes: reason 'clustering quality fail' / activity_count 1314, recorded 2026-05-11 with no method declared and never revisited. The 1314 figure's units could not be established in the 2026-08-03 audit, so no growth ratio against it is meaningful; it is recorded here only as the superseded value.

excluded_topics.reason: No subtopic structure: zero SUBTOPIC_SCORE partitions exist, so there is nothing to publish as a research area even though the topic now clears the cold-start floor on volume.

evidence.activity_count_method: TOPIC#oral_craniofacial_health row count, fully paginated Query
evidence.supersedes: reason 'below cold-start floor' / activity_count 25, recorded 2026-05-11. That reason is now FALSE on its own terms: the cold-start floor is 30 unique PMIDs at score >= 0.3 (cli/backfill_topic.py) and this topic measures 54, so it would clear. The exclusion still holds, but for the different reason recorded above.
